exceptions.reason: Build-tool-only Expo/Metro dependency. Patched releases start at 2.0.3, whose file API is incompatible with Metro 0.83.3's synchronous path-based calls; no patched 1.x release is published. Metro startup explicitly disables ICNS, JXL/JXL-stream and HEIF parsers by content type while preserving PNG/JPEG assets.
